Remark
[Design of optimal controls] ↗ thm:value-function-solves-hjb-equation 1. ch10:10.3-rem-3\group Control Theory

For an initial state $(x,t)$, a feedback trajectory satisfies \[ \begin{cases} \dot{x}^*(s) = f(x^*(s), \alpha ^*(s)) & (t < s < T) \\ x^*(t) = x, \end{cases} \tag {41} \] where at each time $s$, $\alpha ^*(s) \in A$ is selected so that \[ \begin{aligned} f(x^*(s), \alpha ^*(s)) \cdot Du(x^*(s), s) + h(x^*(s), \alpha ^*(s)) \\ = H(Du(x^*(s), s), x^*(s)). \end{aligned} \tag {42} \] Thus $\alpha ^*(s)$ attains the minimum in (23) and is a feedback control. Where $u$ and $\alpha ^*$ are smooth, this produces a minimum-cost trajectory; at nondifferentiability points of $u$, (42) requires a generalized interpretation.
